name: Jesse Lee Peterson
role: American conservative talk-show host, Christian minister and founder of BOND
summary: Peterson advocates male-led families, opposes abortion and same-sex marriage, and rejects welfare and affirmative action as remedies for racial disadvantage. He supports restrictive immigration enforcement and gun rights, denies climate change, and describes political conflict in explicitly religious terms.

universal-healthcare.rationale: He rejects universal free healthcare as communism.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: He criticizes Obama’s minimum-wage increase proposal as part of an objectionable socialist agenda.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: He attacked higher wealthy-earner taxes in 2013 but explicitly declines a position on top-earner rates in 2020.

cut-welfare.rationale: He rejects welfare and government programs as solutions for disadvantaged youth, emphasizing fathers and personal responsibility instead.

limit-guns.rationale: He explicitly favors national carry rights and rejects stricter gun laws as a response to mass shootings.

traditional-family.rationale: He calls married parents raising children the central remedy for national decline.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: He explicitly rejects same-sex marriage and says recognizing it would destabilize society.

abortion-legal.rationale: He rejects reproductive-rights claims and argues that abortion is murder which should not be permitted.

more-religion-public.rationale: He attributes school violence partly to removing God from public schools and advocates spiritual remedies.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: He rejects racism as an explanation for disadvantage and opposes affirmative-action remedies.

reduce-immigration.rationale: He supports closing the border against illegal entry and mass deportation of undocumented immigrants.

open-borders.rationale: He demands border closure against unauthorized immigration.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: He denies climate change and calls it fabricated.

restore-past-order.rationale: He advocates restoring married families, parental moral authority and the national spirit he believes have declined.

reason-over-faith.rationale: He gives divine spiritual guidance priority over human thoughts, which he attributes to the devil.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: He explicitly opposes publicly funded healthcare and other services for undocumented immigrants.

work-for-welfare.rationale: He would deny funded healthcare to adults unwilling to work.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: He rejects women’s political leadership and maintains that men should lead while women follow.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: He supports equal protection and rejects racial separation in 2019, yet continues praising black life under Jim Crow in 2026.

elite-replacement.rationale: He accuses politicians of facilitating immigration for votes and cheap labor while replacing black residents and weakening white influence.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: He advocates equal legal protection across races but explicitly opposes women’s equal voting rights.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: He condemns the exclusion of God from public schools rather than supporting religiously neutral instruction.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: He explicitly calls for abolishing affirmative action, arguing it fosters racial division.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: He explicitly accepts private platforms’ right to exclude anyone provided they receive no taxpayer funding.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: He explicitly places husbands above wives.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: He explicitly describes the conflict as spiritual warfare between good and evil, linking liberal politics to Satan.

racial-group-interests.rationale: He urges people to unite as Americans instead of organizing around racial grievance and rejects racially separate education.

women-distinct-values.rationale: He says female leadership produces confusion and urges men, rather than women, to lead public life.

premarital-sex.rationale: He condemns sex outside marriage for both sexes.

women-suffrage.rationale: He explicitly says women should never have been given the vote and calls their enfranchisement a grave mistake.

racism-not-main-obstacle.rationale: He explicitly denies that racism explains black disadvantage and blames family breakdown and moral conduct.

notes: No inferred answers. All 490 statements and remaining nulls reviewed against evidence across themes. Own columns and complete 2020 interview captions were downloaded and searched; some WND downloads were blocked but the full columns were readable through the web reader. Captions identify explicit answers, not jokes or interviewer proposals. Racial-segregation evidence is mixed: recent praise of life under Jim Crow is recorded alongside explicit equal-protection and anti-separation statements, without treating the praise alone as a detailed segregation-law program. Criticism of minimum wages is not inferred from a colleague’s news segment. Show guests’ foreign-policy views and generic episode descriptions are not treated as Peterson’s positions. Scientific race claims, constitutional arrangements, AI, nuclear power and other unsupported questions remain null. His 2020 uncertainty about wealthy-earner tax rates qualifies his earlier opposition.
